prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a vintage typewriter in use. The focus is on the round, glossy keys with white letters and numbers set against a dark background, their metallic rims catching the light. Two hands, slightly blurred from motion, are actively typing, conveying a sense of urgency and dynamic energy. The composition is tight, filling the frame with the typewriter and hands, creating an intimate, almost tactile perspective. The lighting is high-contrast, emphasizing the shine on the keys and the movement of the fingers, while the shallow depth of field keeps the background indistinct, drawing all attention to the act of typing. The overall style is reminiscent of classic film noir or documentary photography, evoking a nostalgic, historical mood.
